title: Pegboard fit test: the shared hook peg + pin
subtitle: Built only from tools/pegboard.py, the pegs every catalog part uses · hung on a nominal 1/4" pegboard (1" grid) · X out from the board, Z up · mm

dims.label: Room behind the board (hook gap minus board)
Hook leg rise above hole centre

scale_note: Real size. The peg sizes come from the owner's steel hook (5.53 mm wire). The board is a nominal 1/4" pegboard until the real one is measured.
notes: Print this before any other catalog part (PETG, on its side, no supports, about 15 minutes). Hang it: tilt it, push the hook up through a hole, swing the bottom in so the pin drops into the hole below. Check: (1) does it go on and come off like the steel hook? (2) snug, loose, or tight? (3) does the pin seat fully? If anything is off, the peg sizes change in one place (PegStyle in tools/pegboard.py) and every catalog part follows.
